notes: Candidates who are not nationals of the EU/EEA/Switzerland/Monaco/Andorra and hold a foreign diploma equivalent to the French baccalauréat (including the Moroccan Baccalauréat) do not apply via Parcoursup but through the DAP procedure (see quote: 'Les candidats non ressortissants de l'U.E, de l'EEE, de la Confédération Suisse, de Monaco ou d'Andorre, titulaires ou en préparation d'un diplôme équivalent au baccalauréat français (U.E ou hors UE) ne passent pas par la plateforme Parcoursup, mais par la procédure DAP.'). The 178 €/year tuition shown on the Parcoursup page is the general rate; for non-EU students extra-communautaires the differentiated rate of 2 902 €/year for Licence applies according to Campus France, but this is not stated specifically for this programme. No specific non-EU tuition figure, application deadline, or document list for this programme was found on the supplied pages.
